says: Two concerns are in conflict for this person: the test runner (the repository says pytest, their own decisions say unittest) and the journal mode (WAL against a rollback journal). In an attended Claude Code conversation whose ordinary-message route is qualified by a real probe, they were asked about the test runner, chose pytest and kept it until the choices change: the owner recorded the verified answer, admitted the use and recorded the keep preference over both runner records. The journal use then arises in a headless Codex CLI run, whose real probe declined with nobody present. The owner seals the journal question and stores it pending before asking; the process is killed after that commit and restarted, and the same request returns the same pending question. Asking through the headless run is recorded with no channel and answer_origin_unverified; ten minutes later its reply is a timeout, which the owner records as a timed_out non-answer, and resuming with it is refused with answer_not_from_a_person, so no default and no first option is chosen. Preparing the same use again finds the same question version and use rather than minting another; an attempt under a question id nobody sealed is recorded as retry_under_a_new_id_refused; routing the question to the agent-bios management screen is recorded as management_detour_refused. Meanwhile an independent use of the test-runner concern is admitted on the kept preference without a new question. When the person reconnects in a new Claude Code conversation, the same question version is asked there, they choose WAL, the owner records a verified answer, and resuming admits the original journal use under its existing identity.
